ai_summary: IDBI Bank Limited's latest disclosure highlights robust provisional year-over-year growth across its core operations as of September 30, 2026. The bank reported an 18% increase in Total Business and Net Advances, a 17% rise in Total Deposits, and a 12% growth in CASA Deposits, indicating strong operational momentum and expanded market presence. A key point to note is that these favorable financial metrics are provisional and subject to final audit.
